newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico truck drivers hopeful in strike negotiation.
newsitem.headline: Mexico truck drivers hopeful in strike negotiation.

text.p: About 40,000 Mexican independent truck drivers on strike met with officials on Tuesday and said they were hopeful of reaching an agreement to end the two-day work stoppage.

National Truck Drivers' Confederation members met with officials from the Interior Ministry early on Tuesday, confederation spokesman Pedro Cadena told Reuters. Further meetings were planned for later in the day.
"We are hopeful for a solution. We have begun cordial meetings with the Interior Ministry last night...(and) hope there is not a retraction," Cadena said.
The truckers are protesting higher diesel prices, lack of protection against freeway assaults, corrupt highway police and red tape for licenses and permits.
Cadena said the truck drivers are for the most part not resorting to blocking traffic to get their demands aired.
Truckers with the independent confederation mostly transport produce, chemicals and other basic commodities, he said.
